changelog._extraSurfacesNote: public/CHANGELOG.md is NOT a backup here — it is the surface users read. src/pages/ChangelogView.tsx does fetch('/CHANGELOG.md') at runtime, which resolves to the public/ copy. The root CHANGELOG.md is the one nothing renders. If they drift, the app shows the STALE one.

extraSurfaces.note: Fetched at runtime by ChangelogView.tsx — this is what users see. Keep byte-identical.

_gitBaseBranchNote: Consumed by TWO scripts at two different moments, and the split is the point. shipgate.mjs uses it PRE-merge for one assertion only — that this clone is not BEHIND origin/<branch>, i.e. the release is being cut on top of current main. verify-sync.mjs uses it POST-merge for the three-way SHA comparison (local, remote-tracking, GitHub API) plus a clean-tree check. Neither check can live in the other's moment: the gate runs partway through a release with the version and changelog edits UNCOMMITTED, so a clean-tree assertion there would fail every release; and the post-merge SHA condition does not exist yet when the gate runs. Both self-skip under CI: actions/checkout is shallow and detached, so origin/<branch> is not a meaningful local ref there, and a CI runner has no view of a developer's clone at all — which is why this drift was invisible to every mechanism the suite already had. Remove this key to disable both checks; the gate then prints nothing for them rather than passing silently.

commands.name: lint
commands._note: As of v0.51.0 `npm run lint` exits NON-ZERO by design: eslint-plugin-sonarjs contributes 22 cognitive-complexity findings at threshold 15, and this key holds that NUMBER steady instead of gating on the exit code. It is a two-way ratchet — new findings fail the gate (fix them, do not raise this), and resolved findings ALSO fail it (lower this, so the improvement is accounted for). Zero is not the target: 9 of the 22 are in files with no test coverage at all, where the correct response is to add tests, not to refactor. Rationale and the named list of those nine are in eslint.config.ts. IF THIS EVER REACHES TRUE ZERO, DELETE THIS KEY — ESLint prints no `✖ N problems` line when there is nothing to report, and the gate fails in scripts/shipgate.mjs's `expectProblems` branch, at its `count === null` guard, looking for one.

commands.name: typecheck
commands._note: Plain `tsc -b --force`. The ratchet (scripts/typecheck-baseline.mjs + typecheck-baseline.json) was retired in v0.50.2 once the repo reached zero — a recorded baseline number and the compiler can disagree, and the compiler is the one that matters. Kept ahead of the tests so a type error is attributed precisely instead of surfacing as a build failure; `build` below enforces the same thing again, and the two cannot disagree because both run tsc.

commands.name: build (tsc -b && vite build)
commands._note: As of v0.50.2 `build` typechecks. This is the real gate: Vercel runs `npm run build` on every deploy, so a type error now stops the deploy instead of being stripped silently by esbuild. It took 2,183 -> 0 across v0.49.5..v0.50.1 to make this safe to turn on.
